bounded_scope.reason: Project-Frankenstein exact frozen-head tree and full commit-DAG/history denominators remain unresolved; this is a bounded semantic/failure lineage shard.

verified_findings.finding: SystemRealityLayer was added as a ground-truth fact store and injected into user-facing chat prompts; the same reality block was also injected into idle-thought prompts. Ego Governor post-generation regex checks attempted to catch architecture/model/GPU/infrastructure confabulations.

The subsequent deep audit reports that idle-thought RealityLayer injection caused the model to echo the [REALITY] block, producing a 67% rejection rate. The fix removed RealityLayer from idle-thought prompts and added REALITY to the context-tag leak detector. The commit reports 0 prompt-leak rejections in the post-fix 30-minute idle window and a 30/30 conversation test averaging 11.2s via GPU.

A later audit reports a degenerate Neural Conscience state: ACC=0, verdict approximately 0.9999, with 0 negative and 960 positive samples. The stated root cause is missing record_outcome(accepted=False) calls on rejection/suppression paths. The fix adds negative outcome propagation for conscience rejection and downstream hallucination-filter suppression and resets the degenerate checkpoint/cold-start data.

NeuralConscience stores each evaluation with outcome=-1 by default; record_outcome(trace_id, accepted) is the terminal training-label write; train_cycle selects only rows WHERE outcome >= 0. Therefore any terminal pipeline path that fails to call record_outcome leaves the trace unlabeled and excludes it from supervised training, creating survivorship/selection bias even when the evaluator saw the rejected example.

The prompt-leak audit also repaired a silent memory-write failure: autonomous_research posted to a nonexistent /memory/store endpoint (404); the fix stores research directly into consciousness.db. This is another example of an apparently functioning cognitive loop losing learning because the terminal persistence edge was not actually connected.

current_architecture_implications.rule: Introduce TERMINAL_OUTCOME_COMPLETENESS: every evaluated action/thought/gate trace must finish as ACCEPT, REJECT, ABSTAIN/UNKNOWN, ERROR or CANCELLED with a durable receipt. Unlabeled disappearance is a test failure, not a neutral state.

Needle/effect routing must propagate downstream disposition back to upstream decision traces with stage/reason provenance. A downstream hallucination/safety/effect rejection must not vanish after an upstream approve decision.

Do not inject complete ground-truth/state dumps into every internal cognitive loop. Context must be demand-conditioned and surface-specific. Internal thought loops should receive compact typed state projections/assemblies; user-facing factual claims can request authoritative reality facts separately.

Persist evaluation trace, terminal disposition, gate sequence, reason code, label provenance and training-admission state separately. Training queries must be able to prove class coverage and missing-label count.

Before online learner updates, enforce label-health gates: minimum positive/negative support (or explicit multi-class equivalents), class-entropy floor, unlabeled-rate ceiling, held-out regression and rollback. A 960:0 label stream must freeze learning rather than reinforce itself.

The language/runtime should make terminal outcome state and effect receipts representable as typed/exhaustive transitions, enabling compile/test-time detection of decision paths that never emit a terminal learning signal.

negative_knowledge: Ground-truth context can reduce factual uncertainty while simultaneously increasing prompt/state leakage when indiscriminately injected into generative internal loops.
A trainable gate can appear numerically confident while being functionally blind if rejected examples do not reach the learner.
Post-generation safety or hallucination filters are part of the learner's causal outcome graph; treating them as separate logging-only stages produces biased credit assignment.
A successful request path does not prove learning/persistence occurred; endpoint/schema drift can silently disconnect the memory edge.
required_regressions: raw-context-canary leakage test across internal and user-facing surfaces
100% terminal outcome receipt coverage over all gate/effect branches
single-class degeneration injection test that must freeze learner updates
memory-write endpoint/schema fault injection with explicit failure receipt
held-out factuality test comparing demand-retrieved reality facts vs always-injected raw reality block
